title: Fix compile.ts silently dropping displayObjects on isEmpty frames
description: Found by the 0519 capstone (CLAUDE.md Learnings, never tasked): packages/swf/src/compile.ts skips emitting displayObjects for frames whose keyframe isEmpty flag is set, silently losing content at publish time. Silent data loss is never acceptable: either the model should prevent displayObjects existing on isEmpty frames (enforce invariant at mutation layer + migrate), or compile must emit them (or fail loudly). Decide the invariant, implement, add a regression test reproducing the original capstone symptom.
